what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Slovenia in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 103 Slovene asylum seekers, and the United States hosted 41.7% of them.
After the United States, the largest hosts are Peru and Brazil.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Slovenia, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 19 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
